<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)

No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5380daa3b0064390708c96ee2b0427a9f1b9c531` → `packageMentionDocs`.

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

git fetch origin a056a2eccd280583a189d35c1292cb62b405fe02 && git checkout a056a2eccd280583a189d35c1292cb62b405fe02

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5380daa3b0064390708c96ee2b0427a9f1b9c531
